title: Welcome to the New Etobicoke Chess Club Blog
excerpt: We're kicking off a proper Posts & News section so members can catch up on results, reminders, and club happenings between Friday meetings.
content:
We're kicking off a proper Posts & News section so members can catch up on results, reminders, and club happenings between Friday meetings.

Going forward, look here for tournament recaps, holiday closures, new member shout-outs, and the occasional puzzle. As always, the club meets every Friday from 6-9pm at Second Cup, and admission is free.

Have something you'd like posted? Email us at etobicokechessclub@gmail.com.

title: Summer Meeting Hours Confirmed
excerpt: Friday meetings continue right through the summer at Second Cup - same time, same place.
content:
Friday meetings continue right through the summer at Second Cup - same time, same place.

6:00 - 9:00 PM every Friday, no registration required. Bring a friend, bring a board if you have a favourite set, and come test out some new openings. We'll post any holiday closures here and on the Events Calendar page ahead of time.
